goal: 视频播放按钮图标，用于 StudyVideoPanel 的播放控制

subject.concept: 圆形外框内嵌三角形播放符号，代表视频播放
subject.symbolism: 启动、开始学习、知识传递，急救培训视频的入口

style.rendering: 线性图标（line icon），纯描边无填充

prompt: A minimalist line-art icon of a play button, consisting of a perfect circle outline with a right-pointing equilateral triangle inside, single color #00B4D8 (cyan blue) on transparent background, 128x128 pixels, clean modern style, 2px uniform stroke with round linecap and linejoin, no fill, no gradient, no shadow, centered with 16px safe area padding, vector-style clean edges, the triangle is centered within the circle, suitable for VR medical training application

must_keep: 圆形外框 + 三角形组合
avoid: 三角形不要紧贴圆形边缘
不要圆形播放按钮改为方形
